items.title: Iran Just Raised the Stakes in the Gulf—These 5 Stocks Stand to Benefit
items.summary: Iran's latest threat against US energy assets in the Gulf sent oil past $91 a barrel, and the money is already rotating into a handful of names before most investors notice the trade is live.

items.title: U.S. Energy Stocks Rise Premarket as Brent Approaches $100
items.summary: Shares of major U. S. energy companies moved higher in premarket trading on Tuesday as crude oil prices extended their gains amid concerns about potential disruption to Middle East energy supplies.

items.title: Premarket movers: Energy stocks rise on Iran tensions, Eaton jumps on UBS upgrade
items.summary: Investing.com -- U.S. stock futures fell early Tuesday, kicking off a shortened trading week as Wall Street monitored the U.S.-Iran conflict alongside rising trade tensions between Canada and the U.S. Futures tied to the Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.8% by 05:30 ET (09:30 GMT). S&P 500 futures fell 0.3% and Nasdaq-100 futures slipped 0.1%. U.S. markets were closed Monday for Labor Day.

items.title: Energy stocks rise premarket as oil prices climb on Middle East supply fears
items.summary: Investing.com -- Shares of major U.S. energy companies gained in premarket trading Tuesday, tracking a rise in oil prices after Iran warned that Gulf oil and gas infrastructure could be targeted in retaliation for attacks on its own assets.

items.title: Why Is Diamondback (FANG) Up 5.9% Since Last Earnings Report?
items.summary: Diamondback (FANG) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

items.title: ONEOK to Buy Brazos Midstream’s Permian Assets for $4.43 Billion
items.summary: ONEOK is set to acquire Brazos Midstream’s Permian Midland Basin natural gas gathering and processing assets for $4.43 billion, expanding its footprint in prolific American oil hub.

items.title: ‘Soap Cocktails’ Help U.S. Shale Boost Oil Production
items.summary: U.S. shale producers are increasingly using advanced chemical surfactants to release more oil from tight rock and boost recovery from existing wells.

items.title: Oil Remains Above $80: Are Permian Stocks Well Poised to Gain?
items.summary: Oil above $80 and rising Permian output could support Diamondback Energy, ExxonMobil and Chevron as Middle East tensions keep crude prices elevated.
